intro.heading: What IP-SAKTI Sahayak does
intro.what: IP-SAKTI Sahayak is a guidance portal for people developing Ayurvedic products. It helps you work out which intellectual property could protect your product, whether something similar is already on record or documented, and what to do next — with every statement about law pointing at the instrument it comes from.
intro.why: A formulation, a name or a label can be copied the day it goes on sale. Intellectual property decides whether you can stop that, and what you must do before launch to keep the option open. Some of it is lost for good by publishing too early.
intro.typesHeading: Four kinds of protection, often used together

patent.name: Patent
patent.covers: A new invention — a formulation with an effect you can show, a process, an extract. Granted for a limited term, in return for publishing it.

trademark.name: Trade mark
trademark.covers: The name, logo or other sign you sell under. Registered by class of goods, and renewable.

copyright.name: Copyright
copyright.covers: Original creative work — label artwork, packaging design, written content, software. Arises when the work is created.

tradeSecret.name: Trade secret
tradeSecret.covers: Confidential formulations, processes and know-how. Lasts as long as the secret is kept, with no registration.

helps.ingredients: List its ingredients and what is new
helps.protection: Answer a few questions on brand, creative work and confidentiality
helps.result: See what may already exist, for each kind of protection
helps.guidance: Get the recommended protection and the steps to take

need.name: The product or brand name
need.purpose: What it does, and who it is for
need.ingredients: The ingredients, and anything new in how it is made
need.materials: Whether you have packaging, artwork or software

intro.getHeading: What you get at the end
intro.get: For each kind of protection: whether anything similar was identified, what may overlap, whether it looks worth pursuing, and the steps to take through the Indian system — marked as guidance, not legal advice.

coupling.heading: उत्पादन काय आहे यावर तुम्ही काय संरक्षित करू शकता हे ठरते
coupling.standfirst: सांधेदुखीसाठीची तीच वनस्पती रचना तीन वेगळी उत्पादने असू शकते आणि प्रत्येक उत्पादन वेगवेगळे मार्ग उघडते व बंद करते. म्हणूनच सहाय्यक इतर कशाचेही उत्तर देण्यापूर्वी नियामक वर्गीकरण ठरवतो.

classical.product: एका प्रमाण ग्रंथातून जशीच्या तशी घेतलेली पारंपरिक रचना
classical.ip: घटक रचना नाही — हे दस्तऐवजीकरण केलेले पारंपरिक ज्ञान आहे. ब्रँड नाव, पॅकेजिंग आणि कलाकृती अजूनही तुमची असू शकते.
classical.abs: जैविक संसाधनाचा वापर केल्यास जबाबदाऱ्या असू शकतात, उत्पादनाची स्थिती काहीही असली तरीही.

proprietary.product: घटक किंवा डोसचे स्वरूप बदललेले मालकीचे औषध
proprietary.ip: तुम्ही प्रत्यक्षात काय बदलले यावर युक्तिवाद केला जाऊ शकतो, परंतु पारंपरिक रचना उर्वरित भागासाठी पूर्व कला म्हणून उभी राहते.
proprietary.regulatory: स्वतःच्या परवाना अटींसह पेटंट किंवा मालकीचा मार्ग.
proprietary.abs: त्याच जबाबदाऱ्या, आणि त्या आता तुम्ही दाखल करत असलेल्या कोणत्याही गोष्टीशी संबंधित असतात.

newDrug.product: नवीन गैर-पारंपरिक औषध, किंवा प्रमाणित अर्क
newDrug.ip: सर्वात जास्त वाव — शुद्ध केलेला घटक किंवा नवीन प्रक्रियेवर स्वतःच्या गुणवत्तेनुसार दावा केला जाऊ शकतो.
newDrug.regulatory: नवीन औषध मार्ग, जो ग्रंथांऐवजी पुराव्यांची मागणी करतो.
newDrug.abs: कर्तव्ये लागू होतात आणि जैविक स्रोताचा खुलासा करणे अर्जाचा भाग बनते.

coupling.note: हे सामान्य स्वरूप आहे. तपशील स्रोतांसह जोडलेल्या उत्तरात असतो, मुख्यपृष्ठावर नाही.

covers.heading: एकाच उत्पादनाबद्दल विचारले जाणारे दोन प्रश्न
covers.ipQuestion: मी यातील हक्क कसे सुरक्षित करू किंवा समजू?
covers.regQuestion: हे विकण्यापूर्वी मला काय करणे आवश्यक आहे?
covers.band: सीमा ओलांडून, भारतीय उत्तर आणि निर्यात उत्तर वेगवेगळ्या स्रोतांतून स्वतंत्रपणे तयार केले जाते आणि कधीही एका परिच्छेदात एकत्र केले जात नाही.

answer.heading: उत्तर कसे दिसते
answer.standfirst: प्रत्येक दावा त्याच्या मागे असलेल्या उताऱ्याकडे निर्देश करतो. कोणताही स्रोत नसलेली वाक्ये तशी चिन्हांकित केली आहेत. अधिकारक्षेत्र बदलल्याने उत्तर बदलते, ते रुंदावत नाही.
answer.question: आम्ही एका पारंपरिक पॉलीहर्बल रचनेत बदल केले आहेत आणि ते भारत व युकेमध्ये विकू इच्छितो. आम्ही प्रथम काय ठरवावे?

languages.heading: तुम्ही काम करता त्या भाषेत विचारा
languages.standfirst: तुम्ही टाइप करता त्यावरून भाषा ओळखली जाते; तुम्ही ती बदलू शकता. उत्तरे त्याच भाषेत येतात आणि मूळ दस्तऐवज ज्या भाषेत प्रकाशित झाले होते त्याच भाषेत राहतात.
languages.note: भाषांतर थर इंटरफेसच्या मागे असतो, त्यामुळे भाषिणीसारख्या राष्ट्रीय भाषा पायाभूत सुविधांद्वारे ही सेवा दिली जाऊ शकते. मूळ उतारे कधीही भाषांतरित केले जात नाहीत — भाषांतरित संदर्भ हा संदर्भ राहत नाही.

closing.heading: हे काय करणार नाही
closing.body: अर्ज मंजूर होईल की नाही हे सांगणार नाही, मसुदा तयार करणार नाही किंवा वैद्यकीय सल्ला देणार नाही. हे प्रकाशित स्रोतांच्या निश्चित संचातून उत्तरे देते, त्यामुळे कक्षेबाहेरील प्रश्नाचे उत्तर मिळत नाही.

patentSteps.heading: Steps to get a patent in India
patentSteps.standfirst: The route an application takes, in the order it happens: what to do at each step, where to do it, the forms involved and the official source to check. Open a step for the legal provision and the official links.
patentSteps.aria: Steps to get a patent, in order
patentSteps.expand: Show the source for this step
patentSteps.collapse: Hide the source for this step
patentSteps.notRetrieved: Summarised from the official sources above. Deadlines run from your own filing or priority date — ask Sahayak for the cited detail on your case.

handoff.priorArt: Turns a description of your formulation into search terms, lists the patent registries to search, and explains who can search the TKDL. It never tells you something is new.
handoff.classify: Works out what your product is, regulatorily, in a few yes-or-no questions. That decides how much of the formulation can realistically be claimed.
handoff.ask: Sends this step's question to Sahayak. You get an answer with every claim cited, or the reason it cannot answer from its sources.

forms.form3: Form 3 — statement and undertaking on foreign applications
forms.form25: Form 25 — permission to file outside India
forms.form26: Form 26 — authorisation of a patent agent
forms.form28: Form 28 — startup, small entity or educational institution
forms.nbaForm7: NBA Form 7 — prior approval before grant (section 3(2) persons)
forms.nbaForm8: NBA Form 8 — registration before grant (Indian applicants)

disclosure.title: Record the invention and keep it confidential
disclosure.body: Write down what the formulation or process is, exactly what is new about it, and the data showing its effect. Do not publish, present, advertise or sell it before you file: an invention disclosed anywhere before the filing date is no longer new.
disclosure.where: Your own records — nothing is filed yet. Use confidentiality agreements with anyone you share it with.

search.title: Search the prior art, including traditional knowledge
search.body: Search Indian patent records, international patent records and traditional-knowledge sources. The Patent Office examines Ayush inventions against the Traditional Knowledge Digital Library, and a formulation documented in the classical texts counts as prior art.
search.where: IP India public search (InPASS), WIPO PATENTSCOPE, the TKDL and the Ayush Research Portal.

patentability.title: Test novelty, inventive step and industrial application
patentability.body: An invention must be new, involve an inventive step and be capable of industrial application. Section 3 excludes traditional knowledge and aggregations of known properties (3(p)), mere admixtures (3(e)) and new forms or uses of known substances without enhanced efficacy (3(d)). For a polyherbal composition, plan experiments that show a synergistic effect — without it, known ingredients combined for the same use are treated as obvious.
patentability.where: Assess it yourself or with a registered patent agent, against IP India's Guidelines for Examination of Ayush Related Inventions.

drafting.title: Prepare the specification — provisional or complete
drafting.body: A provisional specification secures a filing date while work continues. The complete specification must describe the invention fully with the best method of performing it, end with claims, and disclose the source and geographical origin of any biological material used.
drafting.where: Form 2, filed through IP India's patent e-filing portal.

biodiversity.title: Check the National Biodiversity Authority requirement
biodiversity.body: If the invention is based on a biological resource accessed from India, or traditional knowledge associated with it, the NBA must be involved before grant: Indian applicants register on Form 8 and seek approval on Form 9 when they commercialise; foreign persons and foreign-controlled entities need prior approval on Form 7.
biodiversity.where: National Biodiversity Authority, through its ABS e-filing portal (absefiling.nbaindia.in).

filing.title: File the application
filing.body: File Form 1 with the specification on Form 2, Form 3 on corresponding applications abroad, Form 5 declaring the inventors, Form 26 if a patent agent acts for you, and Form 28 to claim startup, small-entity or educational-institution fees.
filing.where: IP India patent e-filing portal. The office — Kolkata, Delhi, Mumbai or Chennai — follows where the applicant lives or does business, or where the invention originated.

complete.title: File the complete specification within 12 months
complete.body: If you filed a provisional, file the complete specification within twelve months of the filing date, or the application is deemed abandoned. The same twelve months is the window to claim this filing's priority in other Paris Convention countries. A resident of India must file in India at least six weeks before filing abroad, or get permission on Form 25.
complete.where: IP India e-filing portal; abroad, each national office or one PCT application through WIPO.

publication.title: Publication at 18 months
publication.body: The application is published 18 months from the filing or priority date, whichever is earlier. Ask for early publication on Form 9 and it is ordinarily published within a month. Once published, anyone may file a pre-grant opposition.
publication.where: Official Journal of the Patent Office, on IP India's journal portal.

examination.title: Request examination on Form 18 within 31 months
examination.body: Examination is not automatic. File Form 18 within 31 months from the priority or filing date, whichever is earlier (48 months for applications filed before 15 March 2024), or the application is treated as withdrawn. Startups, small entities, female applicants and some others may ask for expedited examination on Form 18A.

fer.title: Answer the First Examination Report within 6 months
fer.body: The Controller sends the First Examination Report with the examiner's objections. Reply to every objection and amend the application to put it in order for grant within six months of the report; one three-month extension is available on Form 4 if requested before the six months end. Miss the deadline and the application is deemed abandoned.
fer.where: Reply online through the IP India e-filing portal, yourself or through a registered patent agent.

hearing.title: Attend the hearing, if objections remain
hearing.body: If objections remain after your reply, the Controller offers a hearing, which may be held by video-conference. File written submissions within fifteen days of the hearing. The Controller then allows amendments and grants the patent, or refuses it; a refusal can be appealed to the High Court.
hearing.where: Before the Controller at the appropriate patent office; hearing notices appear on IP India's cause list.

grant.title: Grant
grant.body: Once the application is in order, the patent is granted, entered in the register, and the grant is published in the Official Journal. Any NBA approval or registration needed must be in place before grant.
grant.where: Track the status on IP India's application-status search.

opposition.title: Watch for opposition
opposition.body: Before grant, anyone may oppose a published application. After grant, any interested person may oppose within one year of the grant being published. Grounds include prior publication and anticipation by the traditional knowledge of a local or indigenous community.
opposition.where: Filed with the Controller at the appropriate patent office.

renewal.title: Pay renewal fees — the term is 20 years
renewal.body: A patent lasts twenty years from the filing date. Renewal fees fall due from the end of the second year and must be paid before each year ends, with up to six months' extension on Form 4. Paying at least four years in advance electronically earns a 10% reduction. An unpaid patent ceases to have effect.
renewal.where: IP India e-filing portal (renewal fee payment).

working.title: File the statement of working (Form 27)
working.body: The patentee and every licensee must file Form 27 on commercial working of the patent in India once for every three financial years, starting with the year after grant, within six months after each period ends.
